description: world.rs:2339-2341: if code A is Certain (Indexed) and code B (same global name+arity) is still Pending when demand_function_scope scans, certain_homes.len()==1 -> resolves to A, and the scan never re-triggers once A reaches Scoped (Scoped excluded from future scans). When B later indexes it looks like the sole home. Duplicate NEVER caught. Deterministic (scheduler is single-threaded) but depends on IndexCode job completion order, so two textually-identical duplicate programs can diagnose differently based on parse cost/file size. Strictly a false-NEGATIVE (never a wrong diagnosis). Fix likely needs the scan to wait until all same-name candidate codes settle (Indexed-or-Scoped) before resolving, or to record the Certain home as a fact checked at a barrier.
title: fz-zbp: late-indexing duplicate-global is a false-negative (order-dependent miss) -- second CodeId still Pending when the first scan resolves is never diagnosed
